mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_topups (wallet_id, source_currency_code, topup_status, source_amount, exchange_rate_krw_per_unit, krw_amount, quoted_at, provider, provider_payment_id, provider_status, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{sourceCurrencyCode}, 'QUOTED', #{sourceAmount}, #{exchangeRateKrwPerUnit}, #{krwAmount}, #{quotedAt}, #{provider}, #{providerPaymentId}, #{providerStatus}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT topup_id, wallet_id, topup_status, source_amount, source_currency_code, exchange_rate_krw_per_unit, krw_amount, quoted_at, completed_at, created_at, provider, provider_payment_id, provider_status, idempotency_key, transfer_id FROM wallet_topups WHERE topup_id = #{topupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT topup_id, wallet_id, topup_status, source_amount, source_currency_code, exchange_rate_krw_per_unit, krw_amount, quoted_at, completed_at, created_at, provider, provider_payment_id, provider_status, idempotency_key, transfer_id FROM wallet_topups WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT topup_id, wallet_id, topup_status, source_amount, source_currency_code, exchange_rate_krw_per_unit, krw_amount, quoted_at, completed_at, created_at, provider, provider_payment_id, provider_status, idempotency_key, transfer_id FROM wallet_topups WHERE provider_payment_id = #{providerPaymentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_topups SET provider_status = #{providerStatus} WHERE topup_id = #{topupId}
UPDATE wallet_topups SET topup_status = 'FAILED', provider_status = #{providerStatus} WHERE topup_id = #{topupId}
UPDATE wallet_topups SET topup_status = 'CANCELLED', provider_status = #{providerStatus} WHERE topup_id = #{topupId}
mapper.select: SELECT source_amount, source_currency_code, exchange_rate_krw_per_unit, quoted_at FROM wallet_topups WHERE transfer_id = #{transferId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
